description: Public contact details of an Instagram account from Instagram's web profile JSON: business email, phone and address (only when the account shows them as public contact buttons), contact method, category, website and bio links, plus emails and phone-like numbers written in the bio. Nothing hidden is looked up. Anonymous access is throttled by Instagram (503, not charged). Unknown usernames return 404. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
